proposal.rationale: Replace bincode/serde deserialization of ConfigKeys (instruction and account state), the Vec of stored signer keys and the BTreeSet dedupe with zero-allocation in-place validation over the serialized 33-byte (Pubkey, bool) entries. Validation matches bincode exactly: input length byte <= 37, enough bytes present, bool bytes must be 0/1; state uses the same decode_shortu16_len plus length check, and on a bad bool falls back to bincode just to log the identical error message. Duplicate detection (identical pubkey+flag, same as the BTreeSet semantics) uses a 128-slot open-addressing table. Check order and error codes are unchanged. Measured: store_cu 0.25x, init_cu 0.24x, so_bytes 0.80x; equivalence identical. Only divergence: pathological stored states with roughly 1000+ keys, where the parent ran out of heap and panicked, now go through the normal checks.
